description: Postal code field currently stored as int64, although the evidence indicates the intended type is string. It has 30 non-null values out of 30 records, all 30 of which are distinct. Observed values are numeric-looking and have mixed lengths of 4, 5, and 6 digits, which indicates inconsistent code length and possible loss of leading zeros when stored as a numeric type.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert the column from numeric to string to preserve postal codes exactly as identifiers rather than numbers.

[CLARIFY] Confirm whether postal codes in this dataset are expected to have a fixed length, since observed values contain 4-, 5-, and 6-digit formats and numeric storage may have removed leading zeros.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the agreed postal code format after conversion to string; for example, if 6 digits are expected, values should appear like '410633' and preserve any leading zeros.
